div.div: لِبَأٌ Biestings; or the first milk (S, K) at the time of bringing forth young; (Lth, S;) before it becomes thin: (IHsh) what issues after this being called فِصْحٌ: (TA:) it is at most three milkings, and at least one milking. (AZ.) [See also إِنفَحَةٌ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
